gate_status: negative (experiment assessment; see original gate record)
conditions: Completed layer-7 SparseGPT BF16 and fixed-support GPTQ INT4 capability batteries, common BF16 teacher and three predeclared paired contrasts; no learned dendritic recovery.
limitations: Both independently reloaded SparseGPT candidates fail only the frozen GSM gate. The GSM deficit already exists in the shared BF16 pruning stage: INT4 minus BF16 is +6 items, paired 95% interval [-13,25]. Against the previous magnitude50 INT4 control, GSM stays 332 with paired difference 0 [-29,28], while answered-and-stopped improves from 0 to 468 and EOS termination from 0 to 957; termination recovery does not establish an accuracy gain. At exactly the same bytes as admitted dense INT3 GPTQ, sparse INT4 has 24 fewer GSM corrects, interval [-53,3], despite better C4 fidelity and 0.78125 points higher MC. The pairwise GSM interval includes zero, while the frozen admission decisions differ. Both sparse arms have 468 answered-and-stopped versus teacher 567; correct-and-stopped is 169/168 versus 234. These are measured negative capability results for the tested pruning recipe, not a qualification, an E/I geometry result or evidence that all sparse teacher-derived representations fail.

Training executed and selected step 4000, reducing local objective from 0.814512 to 0.249593, versus random967 final 0.269691; raw relative MSE is 0.236937 and centered r-squared 0.560100. Each native export occupies 23,769,007 serialized and 23,764,992 resident bytes. Training verification passed 354 checks over 116 bound files, following 47 CPU tests and 101 staging bindings; all H100 evaluations used the original regular-partition route. The aggregate retains no recipe and no replication candidate. This is one training seed on reused development items; it establishes neither an intrinsic capacity floor nor a final-test result. A full read-only replay reproduces the sealed aggregate exactly; separate gate, count and contender calculations agree. Both complete 1024-item GSM batteries, six 256-item MC tasks per arm, paired contrasts, stopping, source identities and native export checks are verified.
